baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a Vent-free gas heater. A wall-mounted infrared or blue-flame gas heater for propane or natural gas with an oxygen depletion sensor. The Vent-free gas heater is assembled in Vietnam using components sourced from China and Vietnam.

The burner assembly, oxygen depletion sensor assemblies and ignitor module, front and back panel assemblies and wall bracket and thermostatic gas valve and aluminium tubes are produced in China. The gas selector valve and regulators are produced in Vietnam. 

Final assembly in Vietnam: cut, punch, bend and paint, then assemble, tighten and test the heater.

key_factors: Chinese-origin burner assembly, oxygen depletion sensor assemblies, ignitor module, thermostatic gas valve, and front/back panel assemblies
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the core heating, safety, control, and housing subassemblies in China
prediction.reasoning: Following N346005, the essential character of a vent-free gas heating appliance is imparted by its core heating, control, and structural components. Here, the burner assembly, ODS assemblies, ignitor module, thermostatic valve, and front/back panel assemblies are all made in China, whereas Vietnam only supplies the selector valve and regulators. The processing in Vietnam (cutting, bending, painting minor parts, and final assembly/testing) is not complex enough to substantially transform the pre-manufactured Chinese subassemblies.
